title: Evidence conformance vector
description: conformance/evidence/v1/vectors/<name>/expected.json: one conformance vector for an evidence verifier. It names an export directory under exports/, the flags a verifier is run with, and the outcome it must report. Not expressible here: the vector field equals its directory name; export names an existing directory under exports/ (it is absent only for a vector about a missing directory); key paths and materialize paths are relative and inside the vector; a materialize op carries the members its kind needs (symlink: path and target; mkdir: path; add_files: count; add_named_file: path (a file name); pad_file: path and size; empty_path, no_directory and export_path_symlink: none); keys lists every key file the flags name.

vector.description: The vector name; the same as its directory.

description.description: One sentence on what the vector shows.

status.description: shipped: the first private verifier passed it. target: NEW behaviour (the report fields level_enum, weakened_by_flags and anchored_head_record_hash, and the flags --expect-change and --expect-head), which the open verifier and the private verifier both pass.

export.description: Name of the export directory under exports/.

materialize.description: Operations a harness applies to a copy of the export before running the verifier, for shapes a checked-in directory cannot hold (links, huge files, many files).

keys.description: Key files (under keys/) the vector needs.

covers.description: Rule labels the vector exercises, such as level:verified, exit:0 or rule:attestation-gap.

path.description: Path inside the export the operation acts on.

size.description: Target size in bytes of a pad_file.

count.description: Number of files an add_files adds.

flags.description: The verifier options of the run. An absent flag is false or unset.

runner_keys.description: Paths of pinned runner public keys.

log_key.description: Path of the pinned log public key.

level.description: The exact level line the verifier prints, such as verified, unsigned export; null when it prints none (a refusal).

finding_codes.description: The finding codes the verifier must report, as a set; order is not significant.

credential_scopes.description: Whether the credential scope lines name a broker as their source; absent when the vector does not assert it.

network_policy.description: Whether the attestation holds an egress proxy statement; absent when the vector does not assert it.

target.description: The level split into the machine level and the flags that weakened it.

level_enum.description: The base level; null when no level is printed.

weakened_by_flags.description: The allow flags whose use suffixes the level, in suffix order.
